entities.name: Juma Mosque (Balaken)
entities.label: Institution
entities.summary: The Juma Mosque, also known as the Minaret Mosque, is a mosque and historical architectural monument, located in the city of Balakən, Azerbaijan. The construction of the mosque commenced in 1867 and was completed in 1877.
